items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Accordion example: a bordered, expandable FAQ list with item, trigger and animated content panel. Open items take a muted tint, and the caret flips between down and up as a panel expands.

items.name: activity-goal
items.title: Activity Goal
items.description: Daily goal tracker card for habit and productivity dashboards: a 13-day recharts bar chart of focus minutes against an adjustable target line, stepper buttons, a met count and a Set goal button that announces the saved value.

items.name: activity-goal-card
items.title: Activity Goal Card
items.description: Goal tracker card for fitness and habit dashboards: a large adjustable target with minus and plus buttons and a recharts bar chart where entries that meet the goal fill in the accent above a dashed line. Requires recharts 3.8.0.

items.name: activity-goal-card-volunteer-hours
items.title: Activity Goal Card Volunteer Hours
items.description: Example of the Activity Goal Card: a volunteer-hours target you can raise or lower, with a folded shift estimate beneath the chart. The card is a dashboard goal or activity tracker with a chart.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Alert example: an inline status callout with title, description and an optional top-right action. Default and destructive variants; a leading icon moves the text into a second column.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: Alert dialog example: a modal confirmation with blurred overlay, header, optional media circle, title, description and footer. Action and Cancel render as buttons, and a small size is available.

items.name: alert-offline-save
items.title: Alert Offline Save
items.description: Alert example: a notice explaining a save waiting to sync, on a game launcher card. Shows an Alert for offline and pending-state messages.

items.name: alert-platform-change
items.title: Alert Platform Change
items.description: Alert example: a flat notice on a train booking, set in accent color. Shows an Alert as a quiet inline announcement about a change.

items.name: app-stats
items.title: Weekly Installs Card
items.description: KPI stats card for weekly installs and growth: a large total, a hairline recharts sparkline over eight weeks with only the latest point highlighted, and a change caption. Recharts is pinned to 3.8.0.

items.name: arc
items.title: Arc
items.description: Arc ring of light for decorative backgrounds, in three looks: a soft conic fade, an outline with a faint track and bright stroke, and a short traveling highlight. ArcLayer groups positioned arcs; spin is opt-in and stops for reduced motion.

items.name: arc-concentric-instruments
items.title: Arc Concentric Instruments
items.description: Concentric rings example showing the Arc: three outline rings nested at different sizes and start angles, one tinted violet, like the dials of a measuring instrument.

items.name: arc-corner-crop
items.title: Arc Corner Crop
items.description: Cropped ring background example showing the Arc: a very large outline ring pushed toward the bottom right of a light ground, so only a sweeping piece of it shows.

items.name: arc-editorial-corner
items.title: Arc Editorial Corner
items.description: Editorial corner ring example showing the Arc: a huge ring anchored to the top right, curving across the frame behind an issue title and a short line of text.

items.name: arc-fine-cyan-outline
items.title: Arc Fine Cyan Outline
items.description: Outline ring example showing the Arc: a bright cyan stroke that fades toward its end over a faint full ring, a precise, instrument-like frame.

items.name: arc-half-circle
items.title: Arc Half Circle
items.description: Semicircle decoration example showing the Arc: a violet stroke running exactly half the ring on a light ground, a clean curve for calm layouts.

items.name: arc-light-studio-invitation
items.title: Arc Light Studio Invitation
items.description: Invitation card example showing the Arc: a deep blue outline ring with a pale track on a light ground, framing an open studio invitation with its hours.

items.name: arc-low-horizon
items.title: Arc Low Horizon
items.description: Horizon curve example showing the Arc: a big ring centered near the bottom edge so only its upper curve rises into view like a horizon line.

items.name: arc-membership-frame
items.title: Arc Membership Frame
items.description: Ring frame example showing the Arc as a quiet border: a partial outline ring sits behind a short founding member message on a card.

items.name: arc-observatory-conditions
items.title: Arc Observatory Conditions
items.description: Observatory session card example showing the Arc: a slowly traveling highlight and a track-and-stroke ring, with a disclosure for conditions and arrival notes.

items.name: arc-offset-pair
items.title: Arc Offset Pair
items.description: Paired rings example showing the Arc: two outline rings side by side, offset horizontally and rotated differently, one pink, for a balanced decorative pair.

items.name: arc-open-track
items.title: Arc Open Track
items.description: Lit arc example showing the Arc with no track: a short, thick stroke with the faint full ring removed, so only the bright arc floats on a dark ground.

items.name: arc-reverse-motion
items.title: Arc Reverse Motion
items.description: Reverse spin example showing the Arc: a traveling highlight that circles counterclockwise instead of clockwise, showing how to flip the direction.

items.name: arc-short-lime-trace
items.title: Arc Short Lime Trace
items.description: Light trail accent example showing the Arc: a short lime-green highlight tracing a small stretch of ring, reading like a trail of light.

items.name: arc-sleep-report
items.title: Arc Sleep Report
items.description: Sleep report card example showing the Arc: a dark card for a fictional wellness app with two rings behind a large average, a short summary and two details.

items.name: arc-small-instrument
items.title: Arc Small Instrument
items.description: Small dial mark example showing the Arc: a hairline outline ring on a light ground, sized to sit beside text or an icon.

items.name: arc-soft-rose-ring
items.title: Arc Soft Rose Ring
items.description: Soft glow ring example showing the default Arc: a thin ring of light that brightens along part of its circle, a quiet halo behind a section.

items.name: arc-traveling-ember
items.title: Arc Traveling Ember
items.description: Animated ring example showing the Arc: a single warm highlight that builds slowly and drops off, turning once every few seconds like an ember circling a ring.

items.name: arc-two-moving-highlights
items.title: Arc Two Moving Highlights
items.description: Orbit animation example showing the Arc: two traveling highlights on nested rings turning in opposite directions at different speeds for a slow, layered orbit.

items.name: arc-warm-fade
items.title: Arc Warm Fade
items.description: Sunset halo example showing the Arc: a ring that glows pale gold and fades through a dim terracotta along most of its circle.

items.name: arc-wide-chapter-opener
items.title: Arc Wide Chapter Opener
items.description: Chapter opener example showing the Arc: two overlapping rings, one soft and one outline, rising from the bottom right behind a chapter title.

items.name: arc-wide-orbit
items.title: Arc Wide Orbit
items.description: Hero orbit background example showing the Arc: a large outline ring with a thick bright stroke covering under half its circle, a bold curve behind a headline.

items.name: area-chart-01
items.title: Listeners Area Chart Card
items.description: Area chart card for analytics dashboards: a two-series time series of daily listeners, desktop solid and mobile dashed, with a select for 90, 30 or 7 days and a legend that draws the dash.

items.name: area-chart-02
items.title: Fine Listener Areas
items.description: Fine area chart for dashboards: daily listener areas with thin blue and dashed gray lines, light fills, a date range control and a ruled mono caption.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Aspect ratio example: a plain wrapper that holds its children to a width-to-height ratio you set, for images, video and cards. No client JavaScript is needed.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: Attachment example: a file chip with media, title, description and action slots, in three sizes and horizontal or vertical layout. Upload states show a dashed idle edge and a shimmering progress.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Avatar example: a round user picture with image, fallback initials and a corner status badge, in small, default and large sizes. AvatarGroup overlaps faces with a ring and adds a remaining count.

items.name: avatar-care-team
items.title: Avatar Care Team
items.description: Avatar example: large initial avatars naming a patient's care team, with roles and next steps. Shows initials fallbacks in a profile list.

items.name: avatar-moss-orb
items.title: Avatar Moss Orb
items.description: Avatar example: an avatar painted as the moss Cloudy Nimbus orb beside a name, decorative and hidden from assistive tech, with its ring off. Shows an orb as a generated profile picture.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Badge example: a small pill label in default, secondary, destructive, outline, ghost and link variants. It can render as a link, for statuses, tags and counts.

items.name: badge-neoconstruct
items.title: Badge Neoconstruct
items.description: Badge example in the Neoconstruct poster style: square, uppercase, with a heavy border in the theme's gold. Brings the Neoconstruct theme with it.

items.name: badge-neoconstruct-fundraiser
items.title: Badge Neoconstruct Fundraiser
items.description: Badge example: a Neoconstruct fundraising card with a gold match badge, a red ribbon badge, a progress bar and a disclosure. Shows poster-style badges on a donation card.

items.name: badge-neoconstruct-night-shift-ticket
items.title: Badge Neoconstruct Night Shift Ticket
items.description: Badge example: a red Neoconstruct ribbon badge on a tilted paper admission ticket with a perforated stub. Shows a badge on an event ticket.

items.name: badge-neoconstruct-print-run
items.title: Badge Neoconstruct Print Run
items.description: Badge example: a gold Neoconstruct badge, a row of band markers and a bold headline on a dark print-shop poster. Shows a poster-style badge in a promo.

items.name: badge-neoconstruct-ribbon
items.title: Badge Neoconstruct Ribbon
items.description: Badge example: a poster-red Neoconstruct badge with a gold corner folded in. Shows a ribbon-style badge for sale or featured labels.

items.name: badge-neoconstruct-room-status
items.title: Badge Neoconstruct Room Status
items.description: Badge example: a Neoconstruct room list with status badges, one inverted for open, and a disclosure for each room. Shows badges as availability status labels.

items.name: badge-zora-admission
items.title: Badge Zora Admission
items.description: Badge example: square badges for admission and access labels on a paper-grain museum card. Shows badges as ticket-type tags.

items.name: banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: Dismissible announcement bar for the top of a page: start and centered variants, a background slot for art, a link that becomes a full-bar tap target on phones, and a dismiss button that hands focus onward.

items.name: banner-archived-workspace
items.title: Banner Archived Workspace
items.description: Banner example: status bar banner for an archived workspace or admin dashboard: a sidebar-toned strip with an archive icon, a wrapping message beside an outline restore button link, and a dismiss control. Sits above the app shell.

items.name: banner-billing-warning
items.title: Banner Billing Warning
items.description: Banner example: minimal billing warning alert bar with a faint red destructive tint, red text and a bottom border, carrying a payment failed message, an update link and dismiss. The tint deepens in dark mode.

items.name: banner-blue-glow-line
items.title: Banner Blue Glow Line
items.description: Banner example: dark centered launch announcement banner for SaaS on a cool near-black ground, with a blue glow line lighting its bottom edge, an arrow link and a dismiss button. Shorter copy on phones.

items.name: banner-bookshop
items.title: Banner Bookshop
items.description: Example of the Banner component: a centered notice inside a double rule above an understated bookshop masthead.

items.name: banner-corner-sheen
items.title: Banner Corner Sheen
items.description: Banner example: release notes announcement banner, centered on a card-colored bar with a sheen of light spilling from the top-left corner, one short line of version news, a what-changed link and a dismiss button.

items.name: banner-dark-glow-seam
items.title: Banner Dark Glow Seam
items.description: Banner example: dark documentation announcement banner with a glowing light seam along its bottom edge, a guide link and a dismiss button. The dark scope keeps it consistent on any page.

items.name: banner-dark-paper-texture
items.title: Banner Dark Paper Texture
items.description: Banner example: dark pre-order announcement banner with a paper texture: a charcoal gradient with printed grain over the content, one line of editorial copy and a pre-order link. Dark mode is scoped to the banner itself.

items.name: banner-exhibition
items.title: Banner Exhibition
items.description: Example of the Banner component: an announcement strip above a sparse exhibition poster layout.

items.name: banner-gradient-live-event
items.title: Banner Gradient Live Event
items.description: Banner example: centered live event banner for a webinar or livestream: a page-colored strip washed with a faint colorful gradient across the chart colors, with a join link and dismiss button.

items.name: banner-maintenance-notice
items.title: Banner Maintenance Notice
items.description: Banner example: minimal start-aligned maintenance notice for system status and downtime: a card-colored bar with a bottom border, a clock icon hidden on phones, a status-page link and a dismiss button.

items.name: banner-museum-notice
items.title: Banner Museum Notice
items.description: Example of the Banner component on a museum visit page, opened by a dismissible notice with paper grain behind the text.

items.name: banner-muted-release
items.title: Banner Muted Release
items.description: Banner example: minimal centered announcement bar on a muted ground for release notes: a short message, an arrow link and a dismiss button. A shorter line replaces the message on small screens.

items.name: banner-neoconstruct-event
items.title: Banner Neoconstruct Event
items.description: Banner example: retro constructivist event banner on cream paper with a hard ink rule below: a red ribbon badge for seats left, a workshop notice and a small call to action button with an arrow and offset shadow.

items.name: banner-new-feature-badge
items.title: Banner New Feature Badge
items.description: Banner example: product update announcement banner in the accent color: a New badge before the message, an arrow link to the feature and a dismiss button. A shorter line swaps in on small screens.

items.name: banner-primary-color
items.title: Banner Primary Color
items.description: Banner example: minimal promo announcement bar filled with the primary brand color and matching text, with an arrow link and a dismiss button. The message shortens on small screens.

items.name: banner-raised-referral
items.title: Banner Raised Referral
items.description: Banner example: referral program promo banner, start-aligned on a raised surface with a top highlight and soft drop shadow lifting it off the page, plus an invite friends link and dismiss button.

items.name: banner-release-bulletin
items.title: Banner Release Bulletin
items.description: Example of the Banner component as a release bulletin: a status mark beside the notice, with a textured background slot behind it.

items.name: banner-shaded-url-change
items.title: Banner Shaded Url Change
items.description: Banner example: migration notice bar for docs and devtools: a start-aligned panel shading toward its foot, announcing a moved URL with a config link. Copy shortens on small screens.

items.name: bar-chart-01
items.title: Monthly Column Bar Chart
items.description: Vertical bar chart card for monthly stats: a column chart of sessions with the value printed above each rounded bar, and a footer with a trend sentence, icon and note.

items.name: bar-chart-02
items.title: Horizontal Ranking Bar Chart
items.description: Horizontal bar chart card for a leaderboard: five countries ranked by listeners, with country names on the axis and values printed at the end of each bar.

items.name: bar-chart-03
items.title: Diverging Bar Chart
items.description: Positive and negative bar chart card for weekly change: a diverging column chart of week-on-week variance by day, bars rising and falling from a zero line with signed percentage labels.

items.name: bar-chart-04
items.title: Fine Session Bars
items.description: Fine bar chart for dashboards: slim square-ended monthly session bars with the latest month in blue, a large current value and a ruled mono caption.

items.name: bar-chart-05
items.title: Fine Country Bars
items.description: Fine horizontal bar chart for dashboards: slim listener bars with country labels, exact values and a ruled October caption.

items.name: bar-chart-06
items.title: Fine Weekly Change
items.description: Fine positive and negative bar chart for dashboards: listening-time bars with a dashed zero line, signed tooltip values and a weekly summary.

items.name: bevel-frame
items.title: Bevel Frame
items.description: Picture frame for inside a card: small rounded corners with a thin white outline at low opacity inside the edge in dark mode. Give it a height or aspect ratio; it clips what is inside.

items.name: blue-hour-scene
items.title: Blue Hour Scene
items.description: Pre-dawn sunrise landscape background: a sky over a dark horizon with a warm glow line and an optional Venus point. Town mode adds a silhouetted roofline with dim lit windows, textured with soft grain.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Breadcrumb example: a navigation trail of list, item, link, current page, caret separator and ellipsis parts. The link part can be replaced by a framework router link.

items.name: bubble
items.title: Bubble
items.description: Chat bubble component with group, content and reactions parts. Variants cover primary, secondary, muted, a primary-tinted fill, outline, ghost and destructive, for message threads and AI chat.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Button example: default, outline, secondary, ghost, destructive and link variants. Sizes run from extra small to large plus four square icon sizes, with focus ring and invalid states.

items.name: button-calendar-download
items.title: Button Calendar Download
items.description: Button example: an outline button that downloads a calendar event, on a single-grain dark card. Shows an add-to-calendar action.

items.name: button-embossed
items.title: Button Embossed
items.description: Button example: embossed, the paper raised a hair with the ink as the label, on cream paper, and black paper in dark mode. A tactile button style.

items.name: button-frosted
items.title: Button Frosted
items.description: Button example: a frosted glass button over a rising Moon Sphere, with a see-through fill, a hairline and a soft inner glow, blurred over the light behind.

items.name: button-frosted-blue-hour
items.title: Button Frosted Blue Hour
items.description: Button example: a wide frosted pill floating over a blue wash, with a quiet caption and a popover note. Shows a glass button on a gradient hero.

items.name: button-frosted-loading
items.title: Button Frosted Loading
items.description: Button example: a disabled frosted button with a spinner before its label, over a rising Moon Sphere. Shows the loading state of the glass button.

items.name: button-frosted-media-controls
items.title: Button Frosted Media Controls
items.description: Button example: frosted icon buttons as a previous, pause and next media control row, the middle one larger. Shows glass icon buttons for a player.

items.name: button-frosted-pair
items.title: Button Frosted Pair
items.description: Button example: a hero call to action over a rising Moon Sphere, with a solid button for the main action and a frosted one for the second.

items.name: button-frosted-set-reminder
items.title: Button Frosted Set Reminder
items.description: Button example: a frosted button over a large arc and grain on a festival card that downloads a calendar file for the set. Shows a reminder action.

items.name: button-frosted-sizes
items.title: Button Frosted Sizes
items.description: Button example: the frosted button in each size, extra small to large, each beside its matching square icon button, over light rising from the bottom edge.

items.name: button-frosted-with-icon
items.title: Button Frosted With Icon
items.description: Button example: a frosted button with a play icon before its label, over light rising from the bottom edge. Shows an icon with a glass button.

items.name: button-gradient-border
items.title: Button Gradient Border
items.description: Button example: a dark pill with a thin sky-blue edge that fades at both ends, made from two backgrounds on a transparent border. Classes only, no extra markup.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Button group example: joins buttons, inputs and select triggers into one segmented control by squaring inner corners and collapsing shared borders. Horizontal or vertical, with a text cell.

items.name: button-letterpress
items.title: Button Letterpress
items.description: Button example: letterpress, ink pressed into paper, a dark filled button on cream paper with silver ink on black paper in dark mode. A tactile button style.

items.name: button-link-hairline
items.title: Button Link Hairline
items.description: Button example: nav links styled as ghost buttons where on hover the icon turns sky and a fading hairline grows in under the link from the center. Classes only.

items.name: button-lit-border
items.title: Button Lit Border
items.description: Button example: a glass pill whose indigo-to-cyan edge fades in on hover, drawn by a pseudo-element layer. Classes only, no extra markup.

items.name: button-menu
items.title: Button Menu
items.description: Button example: an outline icon button whose three lines fold into an X while its menu is open, driven by aria-expanded. A hamburger menu toggle.

items.name: button-menu-museum-header
items.title: Button Menu Museum Header
items.description: Button example: a museum header with a square outline menu button that folds into an X and opens a visitor navigation panel. Shows a hamburger menu toggle in a site header.

items.name: button-menu-project-index
items.title: Button Menu Project Index
items.description: Button example: a studio header with a ghost menu button that folds into an X and opens an index of projects. Shows a hamburger menu toggle in a portfolio header.

items.name: button-neoconstruct
items.title: Button Neoconstruct
items.description: Button example in the Neoconstruct poster style: square, uppercase, a heavy border on poster red and a hard offset shadow it slides into when pressed. Brings the Neoconstruct theme with it.

items.name: button-neoconstruct-file-picker
items.title: Button Neoconstruct File Picker
items.description: Button example: a Neoconstruct card whose red poster button opens the file picker for a mix and reports the chosen file. Shows a button as a file upload trigger.

items.name: button-octavia-copy-command
items.title: Button Octavia Copy Command
items.description: Button example: a button that copies a preview-deploy command, in a card on a petrol-blue wash. Shows a copy-to-clipboard action.

items.name: byline
items.title: Byline
items.description: Author byline component for testimonials and profiles: an optional avatar beside a semibold name and a muted second line such as a job title or company. Testimonials render it as the quote's caption.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Calendar example: a date picker grid built on react-day-picker with button-styled navigation and single or range selection. Supports dropdown captions and week numbers.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Card example: a rounded surface with header, title, description, action, content and footer slots. A small size tightens the spacing, and an image placed first bleeds to the card's rounded corners.

items.name: card-cascade-after-hours
items.title: Card Cascade After Hours
items.description: Card example: a compact dark listening card with warm cascading bands, copper ink and a ruled monospace footer. Shows the cascade lines texture on a music card.

items.name: card-cascade-cool
items.title: Card Cascade Cool
items.description: Card example: a dark card with bands of blue rising from the bottom edge under fine grain. Hover lifts it and draws a rose-amber rule on the top edge, honoring reduced motion.

items.name: card-cascade-warm
items.title: Card Cascade Warm
items.description: Card example: a dark card with bands of red to amber falling from the top edge under fine grain. Hover lifts it and draws a rose-amber rule on the bottom edge, honoring reduced motion.

items.name: card-clarice-open-studio
items.title: Card Clarice Open Studio
items.description: Card example: a pricing card with an arched top and sandpaper grain, with an expandable answer in the footer. Shows an open studio booking card.

items.name: card-client-approval
items.title: Card Client Approval
items.description: Card example: a square card tracking client milestones with a thin progress bar and an expandable review note. Shows a project status card.

items.name: card-newsletter-signup
items.title: Card Newsletter Signup
items.description: Card example: a newsletter signup card with a framed Blue Hour scene, a monospace label and a one-field email signup in the footer.

items.name: card-paper
items.title: Card Paper
items.description: Card example: a cream paper card tipped in by hand, with a hairline edge, a soft cast shadow and square corners for an image, on a cream page. Black paper on a black page in dark mode.

items.name: card-stock-dispatch
items.title: Card Stock Dispatch
items.description: Card example: an ink-blue cardstock with a postal masthead and a tipped, tilted cream plate. Shows a stationery-style card.

items.name: card-stock-private-viewing
items.title: Card Stock Private Viewing
items.description: Card example: silver-on-black cardstock with a tipped-in black plate and a blind-pressed link. Shows an invitation-style card.

items.name: card-stock-trail-ledger
items.title: Card Stock Trail Ledger
items.description: Card example: a sage field-guide plate with a numbered, ruled itinerary. Shows a card-stock list for travel or trail notes.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Carousel example: a slide carousel built on embla-carousel-react with content, item, previous and next parts. Horizontal or vertical axis, arrow-key navigation and plugin support.

items.name: cascade-lines
items.title: Cascade Lines
items.description: Cascading lines texture: seven uneven bands of color fading inward from any edge of a positioned container, in warm red-to-amber and cool blue finishes. Used by the cascade Card examples.

items.name: cascade-lines-announcement
items.title: Cascade Lines Announcement
items.description: Example of the Cascade Lines: an announcement panel with warm bands falling from the top and a hover line, for a release note or new-edition callout.

items.name: cascade-lines-section
items.title: Cascade Lines Section
items.description: Example of the Cascade Lines: a wide section panel with cool bands rising from the bottom and a hover line along the top, for a feature callout or section opener.

items.name: cascade-lines-sidebar
items.title: Cascade Lines Sidebar
items.description: Example of the Cascade Lines: a sidebar with cool bands falling in from the left and a lit line beside the selected item, for a reading list or app navigation.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Chart example: a recharts 3.8.0 wrapper with a responsive container, config-driven light and dark series colors, and tooltip and legend content. For line, bar and area charts in dashboards.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox example: a filled primary checked state, check icon indicator and an enlarged invisible hit area. Includes focus ring, disabled and invalid styling for form fields.

items.name: cloudy-nimbus
items.title: Cloudy Nimbus
items.description: Cloudy painted orb: a round disc of soft painted texture under film grain, in coral, lilac or moss. Pick the painting with palette; below 48px it adds a rim so a small avatar or step marker still reads.

items.name: cloudy-nimbus-coral
items.title: Cloudy Nimbus Coral
items.description: Cloudy Nimbus example: the coral painting at 200px.

items.name: cloudy-nimbus-lilac
items.title: Cloudy Nimbus Lilac
items.description: Cloudy Nimbus example: the lilac painting at 200px.

items.name: cloudy-nimbus-moss
items.title: Cloudy Nimbus Moss
items.description: Cloudy Nimbus example: the moss painting at 200px.

items.name: cobalt-slabs
items.title: Cobalt Slabs
items.description: Full-screen section background of royal blue slabs broken by two terracotta ones, with pale light slivers and a warm floor glow under gray grain. Centers its children on the scene surface.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Collapsible example: an unstyled expandable section with root, trigger and content panel parts. It adds only slot attributes, so the open and closed look is left to you.

items.name: color-field-loader
items.title: Color Field Loader
items.description: Color field loading animation: a small canvas of two color fields on a ground, breathing under grain and crossfading through any palettes you pass. Three sizes and a grisaille option; client component, reduced motion keeps only the fade.

items.name: color-field-loader-framed-color-studies
items.title: Color Field Loader Framed Color Studies
items.description: Framed loader example showing the ColorFieldLoader on lilac paper with a gallery caption.

items.name: color-field-skeleton
items.title: Color Field Skeleton
items.description: Loading skeleton placeholder: pulsing bars on a Rothko color field that wait in grisaille and glaze the palette color in when switched to colored. Adjust the line count; the pulse is opacity only.

items.name: color-wash
items.title: Color Wash
items.description: Blurred gradient background panel: two color fields over a ground with film grain overlay, for hero and section backgrounds. Uses named palettes from the shared Orbital table, delft by default, or your own; blur, grain and ground are adjustable.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Combobox example: a searchable select with an input group field, trigger and clear buttons, grouped list, empty state and check indicators. A chips mode adds removable chips for multiple selection.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: Command palette example: built on cmdk with a search input, filtered list, groups, items, shortcuts and separators. CommandDialog opens it inside a Dialog, like a quick-search menu.

items.name: concentric-rings
items.title: Concentric Rings

items.description: Tooth · Workshop invitation: an example of tooth-grain.

items.name: trace
items.title: Trace
items.description: Agent activity log: lines with an icon, title and timing, each marked running, error or pending. Running titles shimmer unless reduced motion is set, and steps expand for details. For AI agent tool-call traces.

items.name: traffic-overview
items.title: Traffic Overview
items.description: Website traffic analytics line chart card: views and unique readers over time, a date range select, a legend and a dot on the busiest day. The views color changes between light and dark. Uses recharts 3.8.

items.name: traffic-overview-02
items.title: Fine Traffic Lines
items.description: Fine website traffic line chart for dashboards: blue views and dashed gray reader lines, with a current value, date range control and ruled mono caption.

items.name: typeset
items.title: Typeset
items.description: Prose typography stylesheet from shadcn/typeset for rendered markdown, MDX, blog posts and documentation: paragraphs, headings, lists, tables and code inside a typeset container, with docs and editorial presets plus a serif reading preset.

items.name: use-cart
items.title: Use Cart
items.description: Shopping cart React hook for ecommerce: a client hook for cart state with lines, quantity clamping, remove, clear and reset, plus totals with pluggable shipping and tax estimates. Exports helpers for minor-unit money formatting.

items.name: use-chat-stream
items.title: Use Chat Stream
items.description: Chat streaming React hook: a client hook that posts a transcript to a chat endpoint and streams the reply over server-sent events. Accepts OpenAI or Anthropic shaped chunks; exposes send, stop, reset and load.

items.name: use-copy-to-clipboard
items.title: Use Copy To Clipboard
items.description: Copy to clipboard React hook: a client hook that writes text to the clipboard and reports copied for a set timeout, or failed until the next try. A late earlier write never overrides a newer one.

items.name: use-product-filters
items.title: Use Product Filters
items.description: Product filter React hook for faceted product lists: OR within a facet, AND across facets, price bands on number fields, sort options, results and a count of what each option would leave.

items.name: vellum
items.title: Vellum
items.description: Vellum texture: a sheet layer combining two turbulence scales, a crosshatch of near-parallel fibers and a soft wash. Warm grounds read brass and cool ones silver; three intensities scale grain and fibers.

items.name: vellum-collection-label
items.title: Vellum · Collection label
items.description: Vellum texture example: a collection label on a pale sage-gray ground with a translucent vellum sheen, listing material, dimensions and edition. Use it for an archive object caption.

items.name: vellum-day-programme
items.title: Vellum · Day program
items.description: Vellum texture example: a one-day archive photography program on parchment-tan vellum with times beside each session. Use it for a workshop schedule.

items.name: vellum-edition-cover
items.title: Vellum · Edition cover
items.description: Vellum texture example: a dark olive-brown cover with a fine vellum finish, a large issue number and the title Objects and their stories. Use it for a catalog or archive cover.

items.name: vellum-field-note
items.title: Vellum · Field note
items.description: Vellum texture example: a dated cataloguing note on parchment vellum about a maker's mark under a base, with a next-time list. Use it for an archive record entry.

items.name: vellum-order-receipt
items.title: Vellum · Order receipt
items.description: Vellum texture example: an itemized order on parchment-tan vellum with a paid total and a pickup note from an archive shop. Use it for a receipt.

items.name: vellum-quote-card
items.title: Vellum · Quote card
items.description: Vellum texture example: a quotation about the things we keep, set in cream ink on a dark olive-brown vellum ground, with an archivist credit. Use it for a testimonial.

items.name: vellum-seasonal-menu
items.title: Vellum · Seasonal menu
items.description: Vellum texture example: a lunch menu on ivory vellum with aligned prices and an allergy note. Use it for a cafe or restaurant menu.

items.name: vellum-studio-card
items.title: Vellum · Studio card
items.description: Vellum texture example: a contact card on parchment vellum with an archivist's name, a London museum street address and an email link. Use it for a business card.

items.name: vellum-studio-letter
items.title: Vellum · Studio letter
items.description: Vellum texture example: a short letter on parchment vellum with an inset address line, two paragraphs and a signature. Use it for a customer note.

items.name: vellum-workshop-invitation
items.title: Vellum · Workshop invitation
items.description: Vellum · Workshop invitation: an example of vellum.

items.name: vibrant-grain
items.title: Vibrant Grain
items.description: Vibrant grain texture: sparkling noise in three stacked turbulence layers, the top one at screen blend so it reads as silver-halide glints rather than surface texture. One strength value scales every layer.
